snippet.title: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando - Release Date Trailer | The Game Awards 2025
snippet.description:
Pre-order now on PC, Xbox Series X|S or PS5 and enjoy the Leon's Secret Stash DLC for free: https://community.focus-entmt.com/focus-entertainment/toxic-commando?utm_campaign=TXC_DateReveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=YouTube#buy

Mark your calendars: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando launches March 12, 2026! 💥

Gear up, drag your friends into the chaos, and show the Sludge God the true meaning of kick-ass-explosive-over-the-top action. 🔥
